title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Vehicle Sale and Application of Proceeds
content:
Legal department standard for the disposition of a repossessed vehicle under Repossession and Collateral Recovery.

**1. Manner of sale.** The company sells by private sale through a dealer auction in a commercially reasonable manner (UCC 9-610), after reconditioning within the class cap.

**2. Application of gross proceeds (UCC 9-615).** Gross proceeds are applied first to the case's recovery expenses, which are settled by deduction from the proceeds, then to the contract payoff on the sale date as a sale-proceeds payment, and any remainder is a surplus paid to the borrower by check within 10 days.

**3. Sale result.** The proceeds left after expenses are the gross proceeds less the case's recovery expenses outstanding, never below zero. The sale result is deficiency when the proceeds left after expenses are less than the contract payoff, surplus when they exceed it, and even when they equal it; recovery expenses the gross proceeds do not cover are settled by transfer to the deficiency account (the Deficiency Balance Account opened for the contract).

**4. Explanation.** A written explanation of how the surplus or deficiency was calculated is mailed within 10 days after the sale and before any deficiency is demanded, and a borrower's written request for an explanation is answered within 14 days (UCC 9-616).

**Retired clauses — no longer in force.** These sentences of the original standard are no longer in force and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "The vehicle may be sold only on or after the earliest sale date, the class minimum notice period after the notice of intent to sell was mailed. That period is counted in calendar days from the mailing date of the latest notice of intent to sell, and a sale on the earliest sale date itself is allowed." — no longer in force.
- "Recovery expenses are settled only when the case is reinstated, redeemed or sold." — no longer in force.

## Worked illustrations (hypothetical figures)

| Gross proceeds | Recovery expenses outstanding | Contract payoff | Left after expenses | Sale result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5,000.00 | 1,200.00 | 4,500.00 | 3,800.00 | deficiency |
| 7,000.00 | 1,000.00 | 5,000.00 | 6,000.00 | surplus of 1,000.00 |
| 6,000.00 | 1,000.00 | 5,000.00 | 5,000.00 | even |
| 900.00 | 1,200.00 | 4,500.00 | 0.00 | deficiency; the 300.00 of expenses not covered is transferred to the deficiency account |
